items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1965-09-13
items.q: If you get to work with Raymond Burke and get to know how he plays, you know that he is really outstanding

ctx.x: There's a New Orleans cult who knows Raymond, but it seems to be limited to those who have been here and have heard him, and who have truly an intensive view into the New Orleans scene.
If you get to work with Raymond Burke and get to know how he plays, you know that he is really outstanding, and I don't think that, well, I mean, there's not many that can come up to him.

Did you have anything you wanted to add, generally, to the content I brought out, or asked about, anything that you think is important in describing your playing, or your career, or any phase of it that I haven't learned more?
